archetypes.name: oos-flow
archetypes.rationale: New pre-ship OOS filer owns multi-branch disposition behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python OOS filing control flow end to end. Focus on idempotency, security-sidecar fail-closed behavior, fork and repo-unavailable carve-outs, and whether run-statistics plus oos-issues evidence are written on every success path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: issue-batch
archetypes.rationale: The filer shells through existing issue batch primitives and Codex combine.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review integration with issue parse-input, allocate-candidates, create-one, add-blocked-by, and Codex exec. Check argument ordering, fallback behavior, sanitization before public issue bodies, and whether failures avoid writing disposition-satisfying sentinels. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
